messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered P1 — inference error-rate spike in us-west. Alert ID INF-20260317-01. Warroom auto-created: https://meet.redwood/warroom/abc123. Please acknowledge.

mike: ack — I see the alert, oncall is lena. paging now.

lena: I'm on it, joining warroom. assigning owners: mike -> infra lead, lena -> comms & routing. @pavel please standby for node-level checks.

pavel: standing by. pulling kube and dmesg logs for the suspected node group. will post findings in warroom.

mike: quick metric snapshot — 5xx errors went from ~0.2% to ~4.8% in the last 5m, tail latency spiked from 120ms -> 1.2s. KV cache miss rate also up.

ashley: product note — confirmed impact on generation and embeddings, some customers (AcmeCorp) reporting truncated responses. tagging CS.

kate: CS ping — informed AcmeCorp CSM. they want a brief customer-facing line. Draft below: 
```We are investigating an issue affecting inference requests in US-West. Some requests may see errors or increased latency. Our engineers are actively mitigating and will provide updates every 15 minutes.```

lena: good draft. I'll post a status page update. Proposed status-page blurb: 
```Investigating — Users in us-west may experience elevated errors and latency for model inference (text generation and embeddings). Engineers are routing traffic and addressing degraded nodes. Next update in 15 minutes.```

mike: mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic to warm standby in us-east incrementally, 2) bump KV cache TTL and enable read-through cache fallback, 3) restart 3 pods on affected node pool. I'll kick off traffic shift in 3m and report.

lena: confirmed — paging to infra oncall complete. @incident-bot set status cadence to 15m and add #incidents-customer-comm channel with @kate and @ashley.

incident-bot: Status cadence set to 15m. Warroom link pinned. Pager acknowledged by lena. #incidents-customer-comm created and members invited.

pavel: logs show GPU memory pressure on node-12 and autoscaler churn; kubelet soft-restart on node-12 in progress. Posting stack traces to warroom.

mike: starting traffic shift -> 20% to us-east now, monitoring error rate and p95.

ashley: I'll coordinate the customer update and finalize the message after we see metrics stabilize.

lena: update: after shifting 50% traffic to us-east error rate dropped to ~1.2%. Keeping warroom open for followups. Owner: mike (infra lead). On-call: lena. Next update in 12 minutes. :thumbsup:
